surprises.head: Nashville was kept to the outside
surprises.body: Nashville needed 26.0 unblocked shots per expected goal at 5-on-5, against its usual 16.2 and a league average of 15.9. Over the last three seasons, a team strayed this far about once every 45 games.

surprises.head: Minnesota leaned on its bottom six
surprises.body: Minnesota’s bottom-six forwards played 45% of the forwards’ 5-on-5 time, against its usual 41% and a league average of 42%. Over the last three seasons, a team strayed this far about once every 20 games.
